questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'before the war'?
explanation: Antebellum is correct - A-N-T-E-B-E-L-L-U-M. The prefix ANTE means before. Antebellum refers to the period before a war. Double L.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'to write between lines'?
explanation: Interpolate is correct - I-N-T-E-R-P-O-L-A-T-E. The prefix INTER means between. To interpolate means to insert between existing elements.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with suffix meaning 'capable of being bent'?
explanation: Flexible is correct - F-L-E-X-I-B-L-E. The suffix IBLE means capable of. Flexible means able to bend easily.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'not normal'?
explanation: Abnormal is correct - A-B-N-O-R-M-A-L. The prefix AB means away from. Abnormal means deviating from what is normal.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with suffix meaning 'the quality of being just'?
explanation: Justice is correct - J-U-S-T-I-C-E. The suffix ICE forms a noun. Justice means fairness and rightness.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'to look at ahead'?
explanation: Foresight is correct - F-O-R-E-S-I-G-H-T. The prefix FORE means before. Foresight is the ability to predict future events.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with suffix meaning 'acting against the law'?
explanation: Unlawful is correct - U-N-L-A-W-F-U-L. The prefix UN and suffix FUL combine with law. Unlawful means not permitted by law.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'between two countries'?
explanation: Bilateral is correct - B-I-L-A-T-E-R-A-L. The prefix BI means two. Bilateral means involving two sides or countries.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with suffix meaning 'full of grace'?
explanation: Graceful is correct - G-R-A-C-E-F-U-L. The suffix FUL means full of. Graceful means having grace and elegance.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'all-powerful'?
explanation: Omnipotent is correct - O-M-N-I-P-O-T-E-N-T. The prefix OMNI means all. Omnipotent means having unlimited power.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'not relevant'?
explanation: Irrelevant is correct - I-R-R-E-L-E-V-A-N-T. The prefix IR means not. Irrelevant means not connected to the matter. Double R.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with suffix meaning 'the state of being free'?
explanation: Liberation is correct - L-I-B-E-R-A-T-I-O-N. The suffix TION forms a noun. Liberation means freedom from imprisonment or oppression.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'to mix before'?
explanation: Predetermine is correct - P-R-E-D-E-T-E-R-M-I-N-E. The prefix PRE means before. To predetermine means to decide in advance.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'to write together'?
explanation: Collaborate is correct - C-O-L-L-A-B-O-R-A-T-E. The prefix COL means together. To collaborate means to work jointly. Double L.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with suffix meaning 'the act of being pure'?
explanation: Purification is correct - P-U-R-I-F-I-C-A-T-I-O-N. The suffix ION forms a noun. Purification is the process of making something pure.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with root meaning 'to go back'?
explanation: Regression is correct - R-E-G-R-E-S-S-I-O-N. The prefix RE means back. Regression means a return to an earlier state. Double S.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'to go beyond'?
explanation: Transcend is correct - T-R-A-N-S-C-E-N-D. The prefix TRANS means beyond. To transcend means to go beyond normal limits.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with suffix meaning 'causing wonder'?
explanation: Miraculous is correct - M-I-R-A-C-U-L-O-U-S. The suffix OUS means full of. Miraculous means remarkable and wonderful.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'against social norms'?
explanation: Antisocial is correct - A-N-T-I-S-O-C-I-A-L. The prefix ANTI means against. Antisocial means contrary to the norms of society.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'to see beforehand'?
explanation: Anticipate is correct - A-N-T-I-C-I-P-A-T-E. The prefix ANTI means before. To anticipate means to expect or look forward to something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with suffix meaning 'the study of past events'?
explanation: Archaeology is correct - A-R-C-H-A-E-O-L-O-G-Y. The suffix OLOGY means the study of. Archaeology studies ancient human history.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'throughout time'?
explanation: Perpetual is correct - P-E-R-P-E-T-U-A-L. The prefix PER means through or throughout. Perpetual means continuing forever.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with suffix meaning 'the act of transforming'?
explanation: Metamorphosis is correct - M-E-T-A-M-O-R-P-H-O-S-I-S. Metamorphosis is a profound change in form or nature.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'to flow with others'?
explanation: Confluence is correct - C-O-N-F-L-U-E-N-C-E. The prefix CON means together. Confluence is the joining of two rivers or ideas.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'to take back control'?
explanation: Reclaim is correct - R-E-C-L-A-I-M. The prefix RE means back. To reclaim means to retrieve or take back something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with root meaning 'to write across'?
explanation: Transcript is correct - T-R-A-N-S-C-R-I-P-T. The prefix TRANS means across. A transcript is a written version of spoken words.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'existing before the universe'?
explanation: Primordial is correct - P-R-I-M-O-R-D-I-A-L. The prefix PRIM means first. Primordial means existing from the beginning of time.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with root meaning 'to turn inward'?
explanation: Introvert is correct - I-N-T-R-O-V-E-R-T. The prefix INTRO means inward. An introvert is a person focused on their own thoughts.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'to project outward'?
explanation: Extrovert is correct - E-X-T-R-O-V-E-R-T. The prefix EXTRA means outward. An extrovert is a person energized by being with others.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'to go around'?
explanation: Circumnavigate is correct - C-I-R-C-U-M-N-A-V-I-G-A-T-E. The prefix CIRCUM means around. To circumnavigate means to travel all the way around.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with suffix meaning 'full of malice'?
explanation: Malicious is correct - M-A-L-I-C-I-O-U-S. The suffix OUS means full of. Malicious means having the desire to harm others.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'against corruption'?
explanation: Incorruptible is correct - I-N-C-O-R-R-U-P-T-I-B-L-E. The prefix IN means not. Incorruptible means unable to be bribed or morally corrupted. Double R.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'to go before all others'?
explanation: Precede is correct - P-R-E-C-E-D-E. The prefix PRE means before. To precede means to come before something else.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with suffix meaning 'the science of government'?
explanation: Politics is correct - P-O-L-I-T-I-C-S. The root POLIS means city or state. Politics is the art of governance.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with suffix meaning 'able to be broken down'?
explanation: Biodegradable is correct - B-I-O-D-E-G-R-A-D-A-B-L-E. The suffix ABLE means capable of. Biodegradable materials decompose naturally.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'to put beneath'?
explanation: Subordinate is correct - S-U-B-O-R-D-I-N-A-T-E. The prefix SUB means under. Subordinate means lower in rank or importance.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with suffix meaning 'the action of spreading out'?
explanation: Proliferate is correct - P-R-O-L-I-F-E-R-A-T-E. To proliferate means to increase rapidly in numbers or spread.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'to go beyond limits'?
explanation: Transgress is correct - T-R-A-N-S-G-R-E-S-S. The prefix TRANS means beyond. To transgress means to go beyond a rule or limit. Double S.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with suffix meaning 'the state of being equal'?
explanation: Equality is correct - E-Q-U-A-L-I-T-Y. The suffix ITY forms a noun. Equality is the state of being equal.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'not understanding'?
explanation: Incomprehensible is correct - I-N-C-O-M-P-R-E-H-E-N-S-I-B-L-E. The prefix IN means not. Incomprehensible means impossible to understand.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'all-knowing'?
explanation: Omniscient is correct - O-M-N-I-S-C-I-E-N-T. The prefix OMNI means all. Omniscient means knowing everything.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'to live together peacefully'?
explanation: Coexist is correct - C-O-E-X-I-S-T. The prefix CO means together. To coexist means to exist at the same time or in the same place.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with root meaning 'to breathe in'?
explanation: Inspiration is correct - I-N-S-P-I-R-A-T-I-O-N. The root SPIR means to breathe. Inspiration means a feeling of creative impulse.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with root meaning 'to write falsely'?
explanation: Forgery is correct - F-O-R-G-E-R-Y. A forgery is a copy made to deceive others, especially of documents or artworks.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'outside the ordinary'?
explanation: Extraordinary is correct - E-X-T-R-A-O-R-D-I-N-A-R-Y. The prefix EXTRA means beyond. Extraordinary means very unusual or remarkable.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'to make smaller'?
explanation: Diminutive is correct - D-I-M-I-N-U-T-I-V-E. The prefix DIMIN means small. Diminutive means small or a word suffix indicating smallness.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with suffix meaning 'the state of being different'?
explanation: Divergence is correct - D-I-V-E-R-G-E-N-C-E. The suffix ENCE forms a noun. Divergence is the process of moving apart.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'before the flood'?
explanation: Antediluvian is correct - A-N-T-E-D-I-L-U-V-I-A-N. The prefix ANTE means before. Antediluvian means before the biblical flood or very old-fashioned.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with suffix meaning 'full of thought'?
explanation: Contemplative is correct - C-O-N-T-E-M-P-L-A-T-I-V-E. The suffix IVE means relating to. Contemplative means spending time in deep thought.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word with prefix meaning 'to work against something'?
explanation: Counteract is correct - C-O-U-N-T-E-R-A-C-T. The prefix COUNTER means against. To counteract means to act against something to reduce its effect.
